worldcombat.skill.gigaimpact.summary: The user lowers its body and charges flat-out along a straight line; a clean hit knocks the target away, but the exhaustion starts the moment the charge launches, so whether it connects, whiffs or is cancelled mid-way the user is left unable to act or move for a while.
worldcombat.skill.gigaimpact.description: The collision deals about %1$s contact damage.

A hit that truly deals damage shoves the target up to %1$s blocks along the charge; hit, wall, whiff or mid-way cancel, the user is exhausted for %2$s from the launch, unable to start new skill actions and unable to move (a native creature's own private attacks are outside this gate).
The charge reaches %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block collision radius; the wind-up is %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.gigaimpact.use.1: Send the target flying and pay for it with your own exhaustion
worldcombat.skill.gigaimpact.use.2: Finish before the target can answer
On: hold back before impact - much shorter exhaustion and a smaller shove, but a shorter charge and lower impact power. Off: pour everything in, charging farther, hitting harder and shoving the target farther, at the cost of a longer window where you cannot act.
Beyond this distance the user will not start a Giga Impact and closes in first. Larger is more persistent, and more likely to whiff in the open.
Below this health fraction the user stops starting Giga Impacts (unless the target is nearly down). Higher is more protective, and grabs fewer kills.
worldcombat.skill.gigaimpact.timing: Very quick on the wind-up, medium recovery; exhaustion settles in one go after the hit or the whiff.
worldcombat.skill.gigaimpact.growth.0: From level 32 the impact gains another step with level.
